title: Too beautiful to be fake: Attractive faces are less likely to be judged as artificially generated
authors: Makowski, D., Te, A. S., Neves, A., Kirk, S., Liang, N. Z., Mavros, P., & Chen, S. A.
summary: As AI-generated faces become indistinguishable from photographs, what people fall back on to judge reality starts to matter. Attractive faces were less likely to be judged as artificially generated: beauty reads as authenticity.
